svg.title: Fig. 83(d) — The evolute of the deltoid is a deltoid three times as large
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 83(d), page 89. Section: evolutes.

g.data-text: The deltoid (heavy) with its three cusps on the circle of radius 3a about O (the circle through the cusps), and its three axes of symmetry.
Draw the three axes of symmetry, each through O from a cusp to the opposite side.
The evolute is a deltoid three times as large, turned through 60°: its cusps are on the circle of radius 9a, on the axes opposite the cusps of the given deltoid (σ = (8a/3) sin 3t).
